climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay, Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: Pinot Noir and Chardonnay lead plantings at roughly 30% and 27%, followed by Shiraz.
